prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a sideswipe while changing lanes. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1431; do not mention it.)
text:
I am writing to advise that this office now represents the injured party in connection with the sideswipe collision that occurred while our client was changing lanes. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and is currently receiving treatment. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, either by telephone, in writing, or in person.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability limits under the policy issued to your insured, along with a certified copy of the declarations page and any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. Please also confirm the claim number assigned to this loss and the name of the adjuster handling the file.

We further ask that your insured, and your company on its behalf, preserve all evidence relating to the collision. This includes vehicle data and event recorder information, photographs, dashcam or telematics footage, witness statements, repair estimates, and any recorded statements. Please suspend any routine deletion or overwriting of such material until this matter is fully resolved.
